name: Heist Haven
detailed_description:
Welcome to Heist Haven, a sprawling, dynamic criminal playground. Dive into an ever-evolving battle between yourself and the cops in a high-octane, action-packed environment! Whether you are planning your next Heist or completing Jobs for your criminal contacts, Heist Haven lets you experience the high-octane action and build the ultimate crew.

  • Online PvE Co-op Gameplay: Team up with a crew of up to 4 Robbers.

  • Vast Open World: Explore the massive, interactive city of Heist Haven. From towering skyscrapers to underground tunnels, vibrant neighborhoods to abandoned warehouses, every corner holds secrets, loot, and dangerous opportunities.

  • Level up your Character & Crew: Create, customise and level up your Character. Progress through the world and unlock new locations and missions by levelling up your Crew.

  • Dynamic Heists & Missions: Team up with friends or go solo to plan and execute high-stakes heists. Complete Jobs and Missions for your criminal contacts to work your way up on the criminal ladder.

  • Customizable Weapons & Vehicles: Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons, gadgets, and vehicles tailored to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear and develop unique strategies to outsmart your foes.

  • Defeat Varied Enemies: From your average Cop to tactical SWAT and even experienced Army units; Heist Haven is filled with plenty of adversaries to test your capabilities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Heist Haven features violence and frequent displays of criminal acts. There is no blood in the game.
